title: Mechanical information sufficiency assessment runtime event payload v0.2
description: ADR-0010 §4.3/§5.2: purely mechanical assessment — no inquiry family, no model-generated conclusion. Inputs come from the structured task/retrieval contract, result/ledger and source visibility gate. Dedupe key (activation_id, contract_revision, result_digest, assessment_version) is recomputed by the verifier. RETRIEVAL-BATCH-HANDOFF-AND-ROUND-SEAT 0ar S1 (2026-09-19, design v1.0 §3.3/§4.2/§7): two optional sufficiency readings join the payload — usable_source_count is the wide-caliber usable-evidence count (dedupe by content_sha256: visibility in {full_text_observed, partial_text_observed} and relevance = direct; the same single ruler as the D1 threshold/cap and the visible countdown) and sufficiency_gap records the shortfall against the batch target for partial-evidence hand-backs (D2 §4.2). Both are optional so every earlier assessment stays valid (zero behaviour change); when sufficiency_gap is present the usable count must be too.

usable_source_count.description: 0ar S1 (design v1.0 §3.3): wide-caliber usable-evidence count — visibility in {full_text_observed, partial_text_observed} AND relevance = direct, deduped by content_sha256. Same ruler as the D1 threshold/cap and the visible countdown; never a model self-report.

sufficiency_gap.description: 0ar S1 (design v1.0 §4.2): shortfall readings of a partial-evidence hand-back — target (the batch sufficiency target), missing (target - usable_source_count, floored at 0), retrieval_calls (retrieval invocations issued in the batch; reported separately from the entry allowance) and note (neutral fact phrase for the gap, e.g. the last three calls added no new sources).
